purpose: Governed idempotent self-scoped create, revise and retire capability for exact Temporal Constraint duration rules with expected-state CAS: B04-E Schedule placement minimum/maximum, plus B08-C direct Activity Session active-duration soft minimum.

routine.return_type: TABLE(constraint_ref uuid, subject_native_ref uuid, material_state_ref uuid, active boolean, created_at timestamp with time zone, replayed boolean)

state_history.material_state_behavior: Create/revise append complete immutable duration rule MaterialStates; retire removes currentness without deleting historical states.
state_history.current_binding: Create establishes current binding/history, revise performs expected-state CAS then advances current selection, retire performs CAS then closes currentness.
state_history.chronology: Accepted mutation time establishes current-history episodes; idempotent replay returns the originally accepted effect.
state_history.immutability_policy: The routine never rewrites an existing duration MaterialState. Same operation id plus changed material intent conflicts.

lifecycle.retention: Mutation receipts and historical canonical states are retained for replay and reconstructible history.
lifecycle.delete_behavior: Retire closes currentness only; no canonical constraint/history delete path is exposed.

obligations: only self-owned Activity or Event subjects are admitted
duration threshold is a positive exact microsecond value
stale expected state and operation-id changed intent are rejected
runtime executes only the governed capability rather than direct canonical table DML
Schedule placement admits minimum or maximum; session.active_duration admits only soft minimum on a self-owned Activity
